note: Point layer in the local frame (x east, z south, metres). properties.y is the GLO-30 surface at the point. Features with story=true are the narrative set; s is the chainage (m) of the nearest point on floodpath.json and offsetToPathM how far the place sits from the channel — a large offset means the place is above/away from the flow, not that it was flooded at that s.

properties.name: Ice-rock avalanche detachment zone
properties.note: Crown of the 26 Aug 2026 detachment on the north flank of the Langtang Himal, between Luri Himal and Kimshung. Reported crown 5140–5200 m; GLO-30 (pre-event) at this exact point is ~4880 m — the published crown lies a little upslope.

properties.name: Barrier lake / landslide dam site
properties.note: Where the runout blocked the Gouba Xia Qu 郭巴峡曲 at its confluence with the avalanche tributary; ~2 Mm³ impoundment, ~50 m deep, breached the same morning.

properties.name: 吉隆镇
properties.note: On the Kyirong Tsangpo, UPSTREAM of the confluence — not on the flood path; its s is the chainage of the nearest point on the Trishuli, not a flood arrival point.
